sentence: This project studies how a gene that helps cells resist oxidative stress causes melanoma to start.
This project builds a working group that supports research on HIV and aging.
This project tries to find the genetic causes of anterior segment disorders that lead to vision loss, using human samples and zebrafish.
This project sets up a laboratory that collects and processes biospecimens and manages a biorepository to study how early-life environmental factors affect childhood health.
This project studies how to get rid of persistent infections caused by human papillomaviruses and the cancers they cause.
This project builds a smartphone-based system that measures tissue perfusion in chronic wounds during telehealth consultations.
This project tries to find out what role macropinocytosis plays in pulmonary fibrosis, using in vitro, in vivo and ex vivo approaches.
This project tests combination therapies in patients with malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors, using mouse tumor models and clinical studies.
This project studies how voltage-gated calcium channels affect the development of oligodendrocytes and myelination of the central nervous system.
This project studies transporters that remove antiparasitic drugs from nematode cells, to help existing anthelmintic drugs work again.
This project engineers yeast to make monoterpene indole alkaloids, a family of plant compounds, using synthetic biology.
This project tests whether an antibody that targets a receptor could change the course of hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia in experimental models.
This project studies whether binge eating helps explain why food insecurity is linked to obesity in adolescents.
This project uses machine learning and an automated peptide synthesizer to make peptide catalysts that form chemical bonds.
This project studies how positive and negative social media experiences affect the risk of psychopathology in adolescents over time.
This project studies how herpesvirus capsids assemble and package DNA.
This project studies how a family of proteins called septins controls transport within cells.
This project tests how well mindfulness apps work for depression, using a digital placebo control condition and smartphone digital phenotyping.
This project uses machine learning and sequencing to study how breast cancer genomic information can predict treatment resistance.
This project uses existing genomic data and biobanks to look for genetic regions that contribute to more than one cancer.
